title: CommandHelpMap entry required for every dispatched command
desc: Every command in WKAppBot.CLI requires a CommandHelpMap entry in csharp/src/WKAppBot.CLI/Commands/CommandHelp.cs. When a command is removed (e.g. d1eaaf2a removed schedule), keep help text for discoverability but scrub dispatch refs in AppBotProgramInfra/EyeCmdPipeServer/AppBotEyeTick/SuggestCommand.knownSubcmds/UsageCommand.
steps: If removed: keep help + scrub dispatch case-blocks
Top-level aliases such as close, kill, and window must also have CommandHelpMap entries when they are user-facing dispatch targets, even if they mirror a11y or taskkill help text.
